note: One owner per production module under src/boardwise, keyed by path relative to that package. Every file must appear exactly once; a missing or stale entry fails tests/test_owner_rules.py. Ownership is about import direction, not about who may edit: see docs/architecture.md, 'Module owners and the import guard'. engines/assemble.py is shared by 540B0.1 ruling B: it maps a BoardSpec onto the public model and imports only core.blocks/core.geometry/core.model and parsers.schematic (no layout, no replay, no compiler), so the BOM and the draw chain consume the same public artifact; the test fails if it ever grows a non-shared import. core/netdomains.py is shared by 540B1: the ground-domain and auto-net name vocabularies moved down from rules/pcb/focground.py and rules/facts.py, so the reviewer and the drawing chain read one copy without any draw -> review import. core/connectivity.py is shared by 540B2: pin_net/pin_company/nc_violation/pin_dangles are one pure implementation used by review and pin repair; component_net (the component the caller holds) is the one net reading, pin_net is only the model lookup that delegates to it, and rules.facts._pin_net is that same object as an alias, so rules.facts and engines.patchpin keep their historical names by object identity rather than a second copy. The readback/stable-net patch points patchpin.readback_verdict and drawapply._stable_net now read core/connectivity and core/netdomains; the draw -> review edge they used to hide must not be restored. core/decap.py is shared by 540B3: CapCandidate inventory, gated capacitor classification, value recovery and CapDecision are one implementation used by rules.decap and engines.addcomponent, while Finding/severity/mode and same-net wrappers stay in review. commands/draw.py is draw-owned CLI surface assembly by 540B4: it registers the historical draw/edit/layout-lint/pintable/spec-validate parsers and dispatches through runtime handler registries or direct handlers supplied by assembly, never imports cli.py, and makes no drawing judgement itself. commands/review.py is review-owned CLI surface assembly by 540B5: it registers the historical review/checkup/triage/evidence/review-mark/parts/bom parsers and dispatches through handlers or live registries supplied by assembly, with only review-engine imports and no reverse cli.py dependency. commands/shared.py is shared CLI surface assembly by 540B6 for bridge/doctor/compare/persistence/arch/intent/config, with parser callbacks and handlers supplied by assembly and no in-package imports. commands/assembly.py owns install-skill registration/dispatch and may reference the existing assembly-owned skill_install module; neither command module imports cli.py.

owners.assembly: may import any owner (it is where the layers are wired)
